review_scope: Independent bounded review of the county's July construction table, Chirisa campus collision, and Peanut exact parcel identity. Research only; no selected coordinate, normalized observation day, curated acceptance, or new site count.

baseline.identity_review: All 150 current site names and stable keys were checked. No Peanut, Chesterfield, Meadowville, or Digital Drive campus is selected. Existing CoreWeave/Chirisa Lancaster Greenfield Road Campus is a different Pennsylvania property, not this Virginia project. Chirisa's adjacent CTP/DDC labels require an internal collision decision even though neither is in the baseline.

rights_scope: Only compact attributed factual restatements and source audit metadata are retained. Raw HTML, government PDFs, rendered pages, county parcel polygon and bulk GIS records remain temporary. Public accessibility is not an open-license grant. No geometry is selected or redistributed by this research packet.

evidence.fact: The table explicitly gives project status as of July 2026. At 1381 Meadowville Tech Parkway, CTP-02/03/04 have two existing buildings and one under construction; Digital Drive at 1551 Digital Drive has two under construction; Peanut at 2100 Bermuda Hundred Road has three under construction. Existing CTP-01 is separately listed, not new construction.

The full-page map visually confirms July 2026 and the named construction rows. Its county-wide schematic pins are not source-specific exact coordinates. PDF creation metadata and later web links do not supply an observation day.

evidence.publisher: Chesterfield County; DEQ form completed by Peanut LLC and county officials
evidence.fact: PDF page 4, an attached county planning-director letter dated December 15, 2025, binds Peanut to tax ID 830651308400000. Pages 5-6 describe 2025 approvals and then-current clearing, not 2026 work. The form's April 2026 signatures are not construction observations. Page 1's malformed facility-location field contains contact information; its New Albany mailing address is excluded.

The undated operator portfolio labels a 230-acre CTP campus and an adjacent 104-acre DDC campus. Different headings and building programs establish adjacent development labels, not necessarily independent physical campuses under the atlas counting rule. Its current construction wording has no observed work date.

The operator describes program construction at its 350-acre Chesterfield campus as having started in 2024. This is historical combined-campus identity evidence, not a May-August 2026 physical observation or an exact address binding.

The operator identifies Digital Drive as expanding the existing Richmond campus at Meadowville Technology Park and describes a new substation on the campus. This supports a conservative shared-campus interpretation; it does not prove every boundary or that both county street-address rows are separate atlas sites.
The county routes users to its Open GIS Data for parcel and address search/download. The page's separate Map Gallery reproduction permission is not asserted to license this parcel service.

evidence.publisher: Chesterfield County GIS; ArcGIS owner ChesterfieldVA
evidence.fact: Public county-owned item cadb8e716a3348eda94352f863338c8f publishes Cadastral_ProdA. Its licenseInfo field is empty. The item is current September 2026 locator data, not July construction evidence.

Layer 3 is ParcelsEnriched with TaxID, GPIN, owner and address fields. Native service CRS is EPSG:3857, ArcGIS WKID 102100. The exact query explicitly requested output EPSG:4326. No quantitative positional accuracy or open reuse license was established.

One feature returned: OBJECTID 150457, TaxID and Name 830651308400000, GPIN 8306513084, owner PEANUT LLC, address 2100 BERMUDA HUNDRED RD, assessment year 2026. The response contains one 126-vertex polygon ring in EPSG:4326. Exact property identity is closed; the polygon is not claimed to be a construction footprint or exported into this packet.

The request for 2100 Bermuda Hundred Road instead returns 2100 OLD BERMUDA HUNDRED RD, CHESTER, VA, 23836, TIGER line 201577532, right side, address range 2002-2398. The added OLD qualifier changes the street identity and the returned point is outside the exact county parcel. Rejected; no coordinate selected.

An independently structured street/city/state request reproduces the same altered OLD BERMUDA HUNDRED match. It does not repair the locator. Census address-range interpolation is not parcel geometry; no related point is selected.

decisions.candidate: Chirisa CTP / Digital Drive, Chesterfield County, Virginia
decisions.temporal_assessment: The full month lies inside the physical window. The existing project convention may allow explicit month precision, but this research task does not choose a replacement day. July 20 PDF metadata, July 23 article publication and later website edits are not promoted to work dates.
decisions.identity_assessment: The county names nearby construction rows at 1381 Meadowville Tech Parkway and 1551 Digital Drive. Chirisa's own 2024 and 2025 accounts treat Digital Drive as expansion of its Richmond/Chesterfield campus, while the current portfolio uses adjacent CTP/DDC labels. Separate marketing labels are insufficient to count two independent sites; retain one conservative campus group pending root review.
decisions.locator_assessment: No exact selected locator is proposed for Chirisa. The county's map pins are schematic, and the unavailable direct DEQ permit was not replaced by a secondary transcription.
decisions.remaining_review: Root must decide the common-campus identity, close a precise reusable locator and perform final completion/cancellation successor review before admission. No day-only exclusion is asserted.
